moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: Cricket's fast-paced The Hundred tournament concludes with its men's and women's finals at Lord's on Sunday.

angles.name: Finals Anticipation
angles.copy: Who's lifting the trophy? The Hundred Finals Day is this Sunday at Lord's, with both the men's and women's champions crowned!

angles.name: Welsh Fire Pride
angles.copy: Was it a good run for Welsh Fire in The Hundred this year? The finals are set for Sunday – who are you backing?

moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season gets underway with its first fixtures this Saturday, August 22.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Hype
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Premier League season kicks off this Saturday. Which fixture are you most looking forward to?

angles.name: New Season Predictions
angles.copy: New season, new hopes! The Premier League starts Saturday 22nd. Who's your pick for champions this year?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Approaching
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds festivals return for the August Bank Holiday weekend, August 27-30, with headliners like Charli XCX, Dave, and Florence + The Machine.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is just around the corner! Who's ready for the Bank Holiday weekend's biggest music event?

angles.name: Headliner Highlight
angles.copy: Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine... Reading & Leeds has some massive names this year. Who are you buzzing to see?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's sold-out We Out Here Festival, celebrating jazz and UK club culture, runs from August 20-23 in Dorset.

angles.name: Dorset Groove
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is bringing the best of jazz and club culture to Dorset this weekend. Who managed to get tickets?

angles.name: Gilles Peterson's Vibe
angles.copy: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival is a hot ticket this weekend. Expect incredible genre-hopping music!

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Buzz Builds
moments.blurb: Excitement for Strictly Come Dancing's new series is growing as launch show recordings and professional dancer rehearsals are underway ahead of its September return.

angles.name: Strictly Prep
angles.copy: The glitterball trophy is getting polished! Strictly Come Dancing is gearing up for its return, with new hosts and pros in rehearsals right now.

angles.name: New Faces Tease
angles.copy: New hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are joining Strictly this year! Who's excited for the new season?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Return Nears
moments.blurb: Season 16 of The Great British Bake Off is set to return to Channel 4 on September 2, with Nigella Lawson joining as the new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off Buzz
angles.copy: Get your aprons ready! The Great British Bake Off returns September 2nd. Who's excited for new bakes and Nigella Lawson as the new judge?

angles.name: New Judge Reaction
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent? We can't wait! The new series kicks off on September 2nd.

moments.title: UK Heatwave Peaks Today
moments.blurb: An amber extreme heat warning is in force for parts of England and Wales as temperatures are forecast to reach 36-38°C today, before easing from Friday.

angles.name: Extreme Heat Alert
angles.copy: Stay safe and hydrated! Today marks the peak of the heatwave for much of England and Wales, with temperatures hitting up to 38°C.

angles.name: Cooler Weather Ahead
angles.copy: Temperatures are set to ease from tomorrow, but today is still scorcher in many areas. How are you keeping cool?

moments.title: Scottish Schools Return This Week
moments.blurb: Schools across Scotland are returning this week, with many pupils heading back to class today and yesterday for the start of the new academic year.

angles.name: Back to School Scotland
angles.copy: It's back to school for many across Scotland this week! Wishing all pupils and teachers a great start to the new term!

angles.name: Summer's End Scotland
angles.copy: The summer holidays are officially over for many in Scotland. How was your break, and are you ready for autumn term?

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The last Bank Holiday of summer for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is just over two weeks away, on Monday, August 31.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: Counting down to the last Bank Holiday of summer! Monday, August 31st is almost here. What are your plans for the long weekend?

angles.name: End of Summer Vibes
angles.copy: One more long weekend before autumn truly sets in! The Summer Bank Holiday is coming up on August 31st.

angles.name: Classic TV Star
